title: The Snail Map on the Brick
youtube_title: The Snail Map on the Brick | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look without grabbing.
summary: At a garden path after a gentle rain, Chioma finds a snail's silver map on a brick. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Chioma shows Joss how to look without disturbing it. Mama looks too, and they leave it where it is.
